name: Regulation d

subjectOf.text: Raising the Regulation D numerical tests by adding an investable assets requirement would probably not address how to remedy investors' lack of understanding of hard-to-value assets.
subjectOf.abstract: raising the numerical tests by adding an investable assets requirement236 would probably not address the question of how the lack of understanding of certain hard-to-value assets could be addressed.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability (2009). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1428387
scope_conditions: under the SEC proposal to add a 2.5 million dollar investments requirement

subjectOf.text: Recent SEC proposals to toughen the numerical wealth requirements for hedge fund investing fail, because they do not ascertain the appropriate level of sophistication or adequate understanding of highly complex financial instruments.
subjectOf.abstract: Recent proposals by the SEC to toughen the numeracy wealth requirements for hedge fund investing fail to ascertain the appropriate level of sophistication and adequate understanding of highly complex financial instruments.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability (2009). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1428387
scope_conditions: SEC proposals to amend Regulation D wealth thresholds

subjectOf.text: The numerical wealth requirements used to define qualified hedge fund investors fail as a regulatory device, because investors who meet the wealth thresholds do not always have the knowledge, understanding, and sophistication needed to invest in highly complex financial instruments.
subjectOf.abstract: The policy fails to take into account investors who technically fulfill the numerical wealth requirements but lack an adequate level of financial sophistication.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Regulation Via Basel III (2011). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1806252
scope_conditions: accredited investor standards under Regulation D and PFIARA
